faq.whatA: A storefront in a single link for creators who promote brands. You gather the coupons from all your partner brands and the products you use, each with its own link, and put that link in your bio.
faq.costA: It's free to start. Just pick your link and sign in with your Google account.
faq.linkQ: What does my link look like?
faq.linkA: Your storefront lives at {host}/@yourname. That's the address that goes in your Instagram or TikTok bio, or wherever you like.
faq.manualQ: Do I have to add each product by hand?
faq.manualA: No. Paste the product's store link and we pull in the name and photo. Then just add your affiliate link, if you have one.
faq.trackQ: Can the brand see the sale came from me?
faq.trackA: Store links can carry UTM tags, so the brand sees the visit came from your storefront.
faq.affiliateQ: Can I use my affiliate link?
faq.affiliateA: Yes. Each product has a field for your affiliate link, and a click on the product goes straight to it, exactly as you pasted it. Coupons live in the same storefront: your audience gets the discount and you get the commission.
faq.shareQ: How do I promote my storefront?
faq.shareA: The link already shows a preview with your coupons on WhatsApp and social media, and you can download an image with your coupons ready for stories.
